title: Favorite Oil Cleanser
date: Bewertet in den USA am28. April 2026
review: This is my favorite oil cleanser.I lived Korea for several years and did a TON of research about skincare. After some trial and error I found this bad boy and it's been a part of my life for almost 5 years (I'm currently 31).When I wear makeup I typically take it off at night, then use this cleaner with my morning routine. Sometimes at the end of the day I'm too tired and end up sleeping in my makeup (I know it's terrible). But when I wash with this in the morning it always removes any mascara still clinging to my eyelashes for dear life.The scent is quite mild. It has notes of citrus, but it's not overpowering. As a redhead, how to handle sensitive skin was one of my first life lessons. This oil is incredibly gentle and it's easy to apply to my dry skin.To use, make sure you rub it into your face for about a minute before emulsifying with water for another minute. Just as important as washing is rinsing. I always splash at least 20 handfuls of water onto my face after using this to be sure everything is properly rinsed off.It's really hard to choose skincare based on someone else's recommendation. If you're considering trying this, you should change only one part of your skincare routine at a time and give it a month before you decide if it's working or not. It takes to see noticeable change in skin!
